extraction.placeName: Rummelsburg (Stadion, Fußballspiel Sparta Lichtenberg – BFC Dynamo)
extraction.summaryEn: During a football match in Rummelsburg, BFC Dynamo supporters set off pyrotechnics and attacked police with bottles, firecrackers and punches, leaving several people injured. Later, eleven people in a Weitlingstraße pub chanted unconstitutional slogans and insulted officers.
